planOverview.strategy: Smoothed ramp-up to minimize injury risk

crampPrevention.mechanical: Heavy slow resistance (Weighted Calf Raises) to handle 97kg load.
crampPrevention.metabolic: Threshold Wednesdays (4:45 pace) to improve lactate clearance.
crampPrevention.fueling: 90g Carbs/hr + 900mg Sodium/hr (Bix gels and drink mix).

weeklyStructure.Monday: Rest from running. Optional 60km bike commute for low-impact aerobic base.
weeklyStructure.Thursday: PM/Evening Trail volume for quad strength (descending technique).
weeklyStructure.Sunday: Progressive Long Runs (PLR) and 'Vest Tests' using Salomon trail vest.

status.architecture: JSON-first data layer (v0.0.6). Long-term vision: Transition to SaaS (API + NoSQL DB).
status.garminSync: v0.0.6: Automated nightly sync at 00:00 AWST.
status.recentNotes: Barefoot beach 8k completed. Strong mechanical resilience after 60k bike commute.
